question: total revenue last year
sql:
SELECT TOP 200 c.CompositeName, SUM(a.MarketValue) AS TotalRevenueLastYear
FROM Account a
JOIN CompositePerformance c ON a.CompositeID = c.CompositeID
WHERE YEAR(a.InceptionDate) = YEAR(GETDATE()) - 1
GROUP BY c.CompositeName
ORDER BY TotalRevenueLastYear DESC

question: AUM & Account Count by Composite
